text: thats not what we want at all. i dont know who would think its smart to keep it mounted. what benefit is that
resolution: Explained that the only benefit of keeping editor panes mounted under route surfaces was preserving transient editor component state and avoiding remounts, but that tradeoff is wrong because hmsc-int already persists durable world/view state through workspace sessions. Changed cart/hmsc-int/index.tsx so the QuadSplit editor panes mount only on the editor route; /compiled and other routes now replace the editor pane subtree inside the persistent shell instead of overlaying a live editor. Verified with SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 tools/rjit ship hmsc-int.
